title: SKAB run other/8
note: Real data from the SKAB pump rig. The shaded band is the fault labelled by SKAB.

alerts.title: Vibration A rose 7.4σ, not yet confirmed
reasons: Only vibration A moved; no related signal confirms it yet.
A real fault and a sensor offset look the same at this point.
alerts.cause: Mechanical change at the pump: imbalance, looseness or cavitation. Could also be a sensor offset.
alerts.action: Check the vibration a reading against a local gauge (a two-minute check). If it agrees, treat this as a machine fault.
alerts.truth: No labelled fault here: this alarm counts as a false alarm in our metrics.

alerts.title: Vibration B became erratic, confirmed by vibration A
reasons: The related vibration A signal moved too, so the change is physical.
2 signals are outside their limits at the same time, which a single faulty sensor cannot cause.
alerts.cause: Mechanical change at the pump: imbalance, looseness or cavitation.
alerts.action: Inspect the pump mounting, coupling and impeller on pump P-101 this shift. Assembly and Packing depend on this station.
alerts.truth: Overlaps a fault labelled in SKAB.
